notablePrerequisites: An opponent has lost life this turn
description:
Cast Flamecache Gecko by paying its mana cost.
When Flamecache Gecko enters, it and Blasting Station triggers, adding {B}{R} and untapping Blasting Station
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Flamecache Gecko.
When Flamecache Gecko dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Flamecache Gecko from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
